Himachal BJP Councillors Face Disqualification Over Encroachment Allegations

Three Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) councillors in Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, are reportedly facing disqualification proceedings. The allegations against them relate to encroachment. This situation could impact the local governance structure in Dharamshala.
